title: Numbers, Graphs and Tables in Presentations
objective: Students practice speaking about data so the audience understands the result quickly.
context: Graph notes: Horizontal axis = time of day. Vertical axis = bee count. Morning: 8 bees. Evening: 12 bees. Equal observation time.

items.prompt: Introduce both axes in your own words.
items.answer: The horizontal axis shows time of day. The vertical axis shows the number of bees.

items.prompt: Compare the two counts. Give the change as a number and a percentage of the morning count.
items.answer: From 8 to 12 bees; four more, a 50% increase.
items.hint: Divide the change by the morning count. Multiply by 100.

items.prompt: Give a short spoken explanation with one clear final message.
items.answer: Evening had the larger bee count in this observation; use the values and avoid a general claim.
items.hint: Try: In this graph ... . The main point is ... .
